source: Owner direct chat after discussing the remaining FPS dependence of MSQ-68 rifle cadence
owner_message_original: заведи задачу на дороботку, взять её следующей надо
owner_message_english_translation: Create a task for the improvement; we need to take it next.
decision: Create CombatTiming01 and take it next, immediately after verified MSQ-68 and before MSQ-69 / EnemyPrototype01.
requested_improvement: Preserve rifle cadence and correct per-bullet timing across ordinary frame-rate changes and a bounded hitch window, instead of the current one-shot-per-frame limitation.
dispatch_note: This administrative preparation creates no production run. The owner's instruction to take this task next persists; it is not authorization to dispatch the remaining family together.
planning_detail: Frame-rate cases, hitch durations, temporal consistency checks and the bounded catch-up contract are controller acceptance proposals for the requested improvement, not additional quoted owner requirements.
preservation: Retain the verified MSQ-68 collision/ammunition foundation and fixed world-time/self-hit policy, PurchasedArms06 presentation, owner configuration, lobby and historical evidence. Player health, enemies and the player-facing time ability remain later tasks.
